howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 安装监控面板：装上后它会每 60 秒推送数据库数据、每 2 秒推送日志到本地面板，在浏览器里显示代理组、会话、频道、用户、令牌用量、上下文窗口、消息动态和实时日志。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加监控面板/仪表盘时触发，例如说“加个监控面板”或“安装 dashboard”。

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. It pushes DB snapshots every 60s and log tails every 2s, showing agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, and live logs in the browser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, e.g. saying "add a dashboard" or "install the dashboard".
